source_evidence: Contributions are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes, but your investments can grow tax free and remain so when withdrawn if used for qualified disability expenses.
question: Misconception: Contributions to an ABLE account are deductible on your federal income tax return.
answer: Correction: ABLE contributions are not deductible for federal income tax purposes. The tax benefit described here is that investments can grow tax free and remain so when withdrawn for qualified disability expenses.
